errors.evidence: The chart displays 28 noun categories on the x-axis, not nine.

errors.text_span: 语、路、句、发、议、程、记、影、导、码、承、书、兴、资
errors.evidence: The noun categories listed in the description are almost entirely absent from the chart. The actual categories are 路, 距离, 地方, etc.
The longest bar corresponds to the noun '路' (road), not '语' (language/speech).
The height of the longest bar is clearly below the 150 mark on the y-axis, approximately 145.
The shortest bar corresponds to the noun '食物' (food), not '刻'.

errors.text_span: 其余柱状图的高度在 60 到 95 之间
errors.evidence: This range is incorrect. The second bar is over 100, and there are many bars with heights below 60.
The bars are separate and do not touch each other; they are not adjacent.
The description omits the full title of the chart, '名词词频图 (剔除集合量词对应名词)', which provides important context about the data shown.
The description fails to mention a key organizational feature of the chart: that the bars are sorted in descending order of frequency from left to right.
